agents.result: 6 JavaScript checks passed; live LLM unavailable.

changes: Each model question must declare both the missing detail and why it affects the next step. An ask paired with null clarification fields is rejected.
Non-question moves require null clarification fields, so contradictory structured decisions trigger repair.
Old or malformed response formats cannot bypass the new check. One existing repair is retained; there is no added review call.
The prompt asks the model to reconcile latest corrections, prior answers, unresolved obstacles and reported progress. Its reasoning stays out of the user-facing reply.
Server role permissions, exact article quotations and source access checks remain in place.
pending: Restore the existing LLM service before deploying or claiming better live behavior.
Replay the prepared 16 conversations / 38 turns on the current model, then run adaptive conversations with fresh wording.
Review unnecessary questions, correction handling, parent-task resumption, usefulness, exact source support and latency separately.
Compare the candidate with the existing deployed release and investigate extra repairs or fallback replies before rollout.
limitations: Structured consistency does not prove that a missing detail is genuinely missing or relevant.
No live candidate behavior, model compatibility, latency or GPU claim.
Current corpus has 19 articles / 24 demo chunks; expansion to 200–300 articles remains untested.

deployment.blocker: Existing Qwen endpoint unreachable; both app deployments report ollama=false. Normal deployment requires embeddings and a live conversation check.
